stories.title: Jeanie contesting family's sale of stake in Lakers
stories.summary: Jeanie Buss is contesting a claim from the rest of the Buss family that they are sharing their remaining stake in the Lakers to new owners Josh Kushner and Bob Iger.

stories.title: Sources: Saints WR Tyson may miss next 2 months
stories.summary: New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson, 22, the No. 8 pick out of Arizona State who injured his hamstring in a practice last week, could miss the next two months, sources told Ian Rapoport and Mike Garofolo of the NFL Network on Monday.

stories.title: Ravens icon Brigance dies after 19-year ALS fight
stories.summary: O.J. Brigance, a former Ravens linebacker and the team's longtime adviser in player engagement, has died after a 19-year battle with ALS. He was 56.

stories.title: Sources: NBA lacks proof Ballmer paid via firms
stories.summary: The NBA has found no evidence showing LA Clippers owner Steve Ballmer funneled money through team sponsors to pay Kawhi Leonard, according to three people with knowledge of discussions between the two sides in recent days.

stories.title: FIFA COO out amid Infantino's WC plan backlash
stories.summary: FIFA chief operating officer Kevin Lamour has departed the soccer governing body in the wake of Gianni Infantino's collapsed World Cup sell-off plan.
